IPT.evidence_source: [/page/25/Text/7] The first goal of Study 3 was to test whether the Chinese version of the POP would successfully relieve and prevent depressive symptoms in the treatment group.

dxgive.evidence_source: [page/26/Text/2] Cut-off scores of 15 and 20 are frequently used with the CDI to indicate clinically relevant levels of symptoms (Kovacs, 1992; Reynolds, 1992). Specifically, a cut-off of 15 often indicates "moderate depressive symptoms," while a cut-off of 20 indicates "severe depressive symptoms."
